whatACheckpointIsHere: The brief asks for a checkpoint every five completed families or every two hours, whichever comes first. This cohort ran PF01, PF02 and PF03 together in one worktree and returned each lane once, when every family it was granted had either been built and committed or stopped with its reason recorded. A lane of four or five families reaches that point before the five-family mark, so there is one checkpoint per lane and it is the return itself.
